items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: The interviewee narrates a story about Emma Barrett's health and a church event, but does not describe a personal relationship, meeting, or professional collaboration with her.

ctx.x: Sweet Alma and their band won that prize that time. Yeah. And Sweet Alma, she's older than me. Oh. And if she stopped, it just left it there. Cause last summer, we had a bazaar at my church. And we had an all day the bazaar. Because that summer we had a visit at my church and we had all day the visit. But we come to Emma and say, that's my church, I've got to go and pray for them. So she came there, that, that came up there and she got over sickness, a few double pneumonia. And the hospital let her out that day…
Well it used to be Father Frank, huh?
